ko: [Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=1.5)]영혼 깊숙한 곳에서 서서히 내 힘을 앗아가는 게 느껴진다. 내부로부터 나를 삼키고 있어……
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]정신들 좀 차려. 이제 막 출발했잖아!
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]안 돼! 행군 중엔 보급을 합리적으로 배분해야 하니까, 지금은 안 돼.
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]아, 진짜. 다들 힘든 것 같으니 잠깐 쉬었다 가자.
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]용사의 여정은 절망으로 가득 찼고, 운명의 보급품은 언제 하사받을 수 있을지……
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]심하게 녹슬었네. 오랫동안 여기에 버려진 건가.
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]음, 이렇게 훌륭하게 만든 걸 여기에 왜 버렸을까?
en: [Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=1.5)]I can sense it. There's a curse on this land.
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=1.5)]Even now, it saps my strength little by little, from the deepest recesses of my soul, devouring me from within until naught remains...
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]Get it together, you guys. We just left!
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]No can do. We each get our fair share of rations when we're on the march. No sneaking in snacks.
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]Alright, fine. An army fights on its stomach, I guess... In that case, we'll take five right here.
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]The journey of the brave is awash with despair, no whisper of when fated replenishment will finally beckon...
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]What is this, a metal hammer?
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]That's some rust. Must've been dumped here forever ago.
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]Hmm. The craftsmanship is superlative though. Why abandon it?
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]No, Kay! You can't eat it!
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_103_1
[Div] Part.01
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=1.5)]感じるぜ、ここは呪われし地だ。
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=1.5)]俺の魂の奥深くにあるエナジーをゆっくりと抜き取り、内側から俺を吞み尽くそうとしてやがる……
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=1.5)]おいらも感じるよ……
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]わかるように話しなさい。
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]疲れた。
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]お腹すいた。
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]あなたたちしっかりしなさい！　今さっき出発したばかりでしょ！
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=1)]ジュナーお姉ちゃん、何か食べ物ない？
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]行軍中の物資の消費はちゃんと管理されていないといけないの。今食べられるものはないわ。
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]ちょっとでいいから！
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]ダーメ。
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]うぅ……
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]もう、仕方ないわね。そんなに疲れたっていうなら、少し休憩にしましょうか。
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]勇者の旅路は絶望に満ちて、運命の補給がいつ訪れるかはわからない……
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=1)]いいもの見つけた！
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]これは、ハンマー？
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]こんなに錆びついちゃって……きっとここに捨てられて随分と経つんでしょうね。
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]ほう、かなりの名工の手によるものみたいだが、どうして捨てられたんだ？
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=1)]あむ──
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]ケーちゃん！　それは食べちゃダメ！
